openwrt_git_support.Text: This patch adds support of MikroTik RouterBOARD 750Gr3, without the need to reflashing the bootloader. Installation through RouterBoot follows the usual MikroTik method https://openwrt.org/toh/mikrotik/common. Since the image isn't compatible with RouterBOARD 750Gr3 installations which have replaced the bootloader, the former used userspace boardname is not added to the SUPPORTED_DEVICES

openwrt_git_poe.Text: This 750gr3 GPIO17 switch was added based on vendor source, but only the 760iGS (which shares the rbsysfs board identifier) device has the physical wiring. The 750Gr3 actually does not support PoE out.

mikrotik_produktseite.Kurz: 5x Gigabit Ethernet, Dual Core 880MHz CPU, 256MB RAM, USB, microSD, RouterOS L4
mikrotik_produktseite.Beschreibung: hEX is a five port Gigabit Ethernet router for locations where wireless connectivity is not required. The device has a full size USB port. This new updated revision of the hEX brings several improvements in performance. ... IPsec hardware encryption and The Dude server package is supported, microSD slot ...

mikrotik_quickguide_2019.First use: Port 1 (labeled "Internet") für Internet, Ports 2-5 lokal; nach kurzem Piepton Netz verfügbar; 192.168.88.1, kein Passwort
mikrotik_quickguide_2019.Mounting: This device is designed for use indoors by placing it on the flat surface or mounting on the wall ... screws are not included ... Screws with size 4x25 mm ... dowels 6x30 mm and 6 mm drill bit ... cable feed is pointing downwards ... Cat6 ... The IP rating scale for this device is IPX0.
mikrotik_quickguide_2019.Powering: Direct input power jack (5.5mm outside and 2mm inside, female, pin positive) accepts 8-30 V DC. The first Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet 8-30 V DC. 12 V or more is recommended to compensate for the loss in cables. The power consumption of this device under maximum load with attachments is 10 W. Without attachments 5 W.
mikrotik_quickguide_2019.Extension Slots and Ports: five individual Ethernet ports, Auto MDI/X; MicroSD card slot; USB type A slot
mikrotik_quickguide_2019.Reset button: Press the button and apply the power: release when green LED starts flashing -> reset config; when LED turns solid green -> clear all config and bridge all interfaces; after LED no longer lit (~20 s) -> look for Netinstall servers. Button pressed before power -> backup RouterBOOT loader.
mikrotik_quickguide_2019.Accessories: DC EU/US Switching Power Supply 24 V, 0.38 A, 9 W, Level VI, cable:1.5 m
